blocks.html: From February 29 to March 6, commuters, as well as private car owners will enjoy the benefits of Robinsons Malls’ Free Point-to-Point (P2P) Bus Service plying Robinsons Galleria – Ayala and vice versa.

Robinsons Galleria – Ayala trips start as early as 5:30am and ends at 8:00pm. Dispatch is every 30 minutes except from 11:00am–3:00pm, which has 1-hour headway. Ayala – Robinsons Galleria trips start at 10:30am and ends at 8:30pm, with 30-minute dispatch interval, except between 3:00-4:00pm. Robinsons Galleria loading/ unloading point is at south corner of EDSA Shrine, while Ayala loading point is at Park Square in front of Dusit Hotel.

Now, professionals and students from Pasig, San Juan &amp; Mandaluyong area can look forward to faster travel times since the P2P busses reliably follow a set schedule and will be point-to-point, eliminating loading or unloading outside of the designated stops. Passengers can also expect better service as the drivers will be professional and fully trained. With HM Transport’s quality-service buses, private car owners can leave their cars at home and patronize the P2P buses instead.
Starting March 7, passengers of the Robinsons Galleria – Ayala P2P Bus Service get to enjoy an introductory fare of P30.00.

Robinsons Malls teamed-up with HM Transport for the P2P Bus Service in order to help the government alleviate traffic congestion on EDSA and ease the inconvenience that the riding public experience daily. To follow very soon is the P2P Bus Service plying Robinsons Novaliches-Makati CBD and vice versa.
